metadata.description: Frame-N demo subset: 100 newborn title-phrase concepts (stratified by analysis group, seed 0) drawn from the 448 concepts with finite OPEN_home and O2r_m30 in data/analysis_frame_n.parquet. input = phrase; output = observed O2r_m30 (later venue-field breadth). metadata_* = rung-ladder covariates, early ego-network indices and outcomes. frozen_full_sample_cells = the psp cells of the single unseal on the full frame (B = 2000, seed 20260929).
